# visualization.design_map.plot_design_matrix { #fmrimod.visualization.design_map.plot_design_matrix }

```python
plot_design_matrix(
    model,
    term_name=None,
    figsize=None,
    separate_regressors=True,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Plot time series of design matrix regressors.

Creates line plots showing the time course of regressors in the
design matrix.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                | Type           | Description                                                     | Default    |
|---------------------|----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| model               | EventModel     | Event model containing the design matrix                        | _required_ |
| term_name           | str            | Name of specific term to plot. If None, plots all terms         | `None`     |
| figsize             | tuple of float | Figure size as (width, height)                                  | `None`     |
| separate_regressors | bool           | Whether to plot regressors in separate subplots when many exist | `True`     |
| **kwargs            | object         | Additional arguments passed to plot functions                   | `{}`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                  | Description        |
|--------|---------------------------------------|--------------------|
| fig    | matplotlib.figure.Figure              | The figure object  |
| axes   | matplotlib.axes.Axes or array of Axes | The axes object(s) |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Plot all regressors
>>> fig, axes = plot_design_matrix(model)
>>>
>>> # Plot specific term only
>>> fig, ax = plot_design_matrix(model, term_name='condition')
```
